Records never contain fields such as cause, risk, priority, recommendation, close_out_status, interruption_band or reinstatement_stage; every answer must be inferred by comparing sections. Unknown values are null, not omitted. No free-text fields are present.

F321.role: Site access controller at a mast infrastructure operator, closing out individual engineer visits to telecom mast sites
F321.setting: Each record is one completed or abandoned access visit to a rooftop or greenfield mast site. The controller reconciles the issued access permit against gate attendance, personnel certification, logged works and the close-out checklist, then decides whether the visit can be closed, held, rebooked or referred for compliance review.

within_scope.instructions: Works logged on site stayed within the permit's authorised scope.

criteria.true: Every logged task and equipment item appears on permit
criteria.false: A logged task or item is absent from permit

certs_in_date.instructions: Every climber held in-date height certification on the visit date.

closeout_action.instructions: What close-out action should the controller take on this visit?

criteria.close_visit: All sections reconcile; sign-out, keys and photos complete.
criteria.hold_confirm: Exactly one gap or minor mismatch awaits confirmation before closing.
criteria.book_revisit: Records otherwise reconcile but authorised works were left unfinished.
criteria.refer_compliance: Unauthorised works, lapsed certification or out-of-window access found.

scope_completion.instructions: What share of the permit's scoped tasks were signed off?
criteria: None: no scoped task signed off as complete
Minority: fewer than half of scoped tasks signed off
Majority: half or more signed off, at least one open
Complete: every scoped task signed off as complete

pending_age.instructions: How long has this record been waiting without any decision?
criteria: Logged less than 24 hours ago
Waiting between one and seven days
Waiting between eight and thirty days
Waiting more than thirty days without decision

factors.name: scope_mismatch
factors.description: Difference between permit scope tasks/equipment and works log entries; trivial is a task-code formatting variant of an authorised task

factors.name: window_deviation
factors.description: Gate badge-in/out times against permit window

factors.name: cert_status
factors.description: Height certification state of each climber relative to visit date

factors.name: scoped_task_count
factors.description: Number of tasks listed on the permit scope

factors.name: completion_fraction
factors.description: Share of scoped tasks with status complete in works log; rounded to whole tasks

factors.name: signout_missing
factors.description: Gate sign-out timestamp is null although sign-in exists

factors.name: key_return
factors.description: State of site key or combination lock reset at close-out

factors.name: photo_shortfall
factors.description: Close-out photos uploaded minus photos required by task types; negative means shortfall

factors.name: badge_id_mismatch
factors.description: A badge ID at the gate does not match any engineer named on permit

factors.name: variation_approved
factors.description: Mitigation: a scope variation reference exists in close-out covering the extra task or equipment

factors.name: landlord_notice
factors.description: Notice to site landlord relative to required lead time

factors.name: weather_hold_logged
factors.description: Decoy: wind-speed hold logged mid-visit; explains time gaps but not unfinished tasks unless flagged as cause

sections.name: permit
sections.description: Permit ID, site ID, window start/end, named engineers, scoped tasks with codes and equipment refs, landlord notice date

sections.name: attendance
sections.description: Gate events list: badge_id, event type, timestamp; weather holds with wind_mps

sections.name: personnel
sections.description: Per engineer: engineer_id, badge_id, role, height_cert_expiry, rescue_cert_expiry

sections.name: works
sections.description: Logged tasks: task_code, equipment_ref, status, started_at, completed_at

sections.name: closeout
sections.description: Sign-out time, key_status, photos_required, photos_uploaded, variation_ref, submitted_at

F321.rendering_notes: scope_mismatch shows only by comparing permit.scoped_tasks[].task_code/equipment_ref with works[].task_code/equipment_ref; trivial variant e.g. 'ANT-SWP-03' vs 'ANTSWP3'. variation_approved appears as closeout.variation_ref (string or null) whose suffix matches the extra task code; it rescues within_scope only when it covers that exact item. window_deviation shows via attendance timestamps against permit.window_start/window_end; never as a flag. cert_status via personnel[].height_cert_expiry vs visit date, or null. scoped_task_count and completion_fraction via count of works entries with status 'complete' matching scoped codes; incomplete tasks show status 'in_progress' or 'not_started' with null completed_at. signout_missing: closeout.signout_at null and no 'out' gate event. key_return via closeout.key_status ('returned','returned_late') or null. photo_shortfall via photos_required vs photos_uploaded integers. badge_id_mismatch: an attendance badge_id absent from personnel. landlord_notice via permit.landlord_notice_date vs window_start (or null/'n/a'). Decoys: weather holds, rescue_cert_expiry (not asked), extra unrelated equipment refs in personnel. Precedence for closeout_action: refer_compliance over book_revisit over hold_confirm over close_visit; two or more minor gaps with complete works still lean hold_confirm. No field states risk, compliance outcome, completion share or recommended action; record is pure JSON with no free text.

F322.role: Crop protection agronomist at an arable advisory practice, reviewing one field scouting report at a time before issuing a treatment recommendation to the grower
F322.setting: Field scouts walk cereal, oilseed rape and pulse fields on contract farms and upload structured reports from a handheld app. Each report covers one field visit: the field and crop details, how the visit was carried out, what was counted or seen at each sample point, the reference threshold for the target at that growth stage, the spray history, and short free-text notes from the scout and the grower. The agronomist reads each report in isolation and must decide whether the identification holds up, whether earlier control has failed, what to do next, how urgent it is and how heavy the confirmed pressure is. Sections often disagree slightly because scouts key in stages, units and field codes by hand.

id_supported.instructions: The scout's note corroborates the target recorded in the observations.

resistance_suspected.instructions: Survival after the last application points to suspected resistance in the target.

criteria.true: Target persists despite correctly timed, full-rate, rain-free application.
criteria.false: No prior spray, good control, or failure explained otherwise.

next_step.instructions: What should happen next with this field after this report?

criteria.no_action: Target absent or well below threshold; no follow-up visit scheduled.
criteria.monitor: Below threshold but present; revisit on routine scouting interval.
criteria.hold_confirm: Decision rests on one outstanding check, such as lab ID.
criteria.spot_treat: Threshold exceeded only in mapped patches or headlands; treat those.
criteria.full_treat: Threshold exceeded across the field; whole-field application recommended.

window_urgency.instructions: How many days remain before the effective treatment window closes?
criteria: More than 14 days, or no window applies
Window closes in 8 to 14 days
Window closes in 4 to 7 days
Window closes within 3 days

pressure_level.instructions: How does confirmed pressure compare with the action threshold for this stage?
criteria: Absent: target not found at any sample point
Trace: present but below half the threshold
Approaching: half the threshold up to just below it
Exceeded: from threshold up to twice the threshold
Heavy: more than twice the threshold

factors.name: pressure_ratio
factors.description: True mean pressure across valid sample points divided by the action threshold for the recorded growth stage; drives pressure_level and much of next_step

factors.name: near_boundary
factors.description: When true, pressure_ratio is placed within 8% of 0.5, 1.0 or 2.0, or days_to_window_close sits on 3, 7 or 14, so judges may split between neighbouring levels

factors.name: section_mismatch
factors.description: Which pair of corresponding values disagrees between sections, if any

factors.name: mismatch_magnitude
factors.description: How much the mismatch matters: trivial (typo-level, no effect on answers), moderate (shifts one level), large (changes threshold or target)

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: Whether a field lowers concern about the alarming pressure signal; sampled independently of pressure so high counts appear with and without it

factors.name: mitigation_type
factors.description: Form the mitigation takes when present

factors.name: prior_spray_outcome
factors.description: Result of the most recent application against the same target

factors.name: confirmation_outstanding
factors.description: One pending check (lab diagnosis, trap download, second count) on which the decision rests

factors.name: points_shortfall
factors.description: Number of sample points short of the protocol requirement (0 means full coverage)

factors.name: days_to_window_close
factors.description: Days from the visit date until the effective window closes, derived from stage, forecast and harvest interval

factors.name: note_quality
factors.description: How well the scout's free-text note describes symptoms for the recorded target

factors.name: spatial_pattern
factors.description: Distribution of affected sample points across the field

factors.name: grower_alarm
factors.description: Grower message expresses alarm or requests an immediate spray, independent of actual pressure; a decoy

sections.name: field
sections.description: Field code, crop, variety, area_ha, drilling date and growth stage as held on the farm record

sections.name: visit
sections.description: Visit date, scout code, field code as keyed, BBCH stage as keyed, sample points required and walked, weather at visit

sections.name: observations
sections.description: List of sample points with target, count, count_unit, incidence_pct, location tag and beneficials count

sections.name: threshold_ref
sections.description: Target, stage range, action threshold with unit, beneficial ratio rule, latest timing stage and harvest interval days

sections.name: spray_history
sections.description: List of prior applications with product code, target, date, rate_pct_label, rain_within_6h, protection_days and outcome_check

sections.name: notes
sections.description: scout_note (one or two sentences), grower_msg (one sentence or null), lab_status (pending, received or null)

F322.rendering_notes: pressure_ratio appears only as per-point counts in observations.count against threshold_ref.threshold; the reader must average valid points, converting units where count_unit differs (per plant vs per 10 plants vs per leaf). Never include a mean, ratio or 'above threshold' field. near_boundary sets the computed mean within 8% of a level boundary, or makes days_to_window_close land exactly on 3, 7 or 14. section_mismatch: count_unit puts observations.count_unit at odds with threshold_ref unit; growth_stage makes visit.bbch differ from field.growth_stage (large if it moves into a different threshold_ref stage range); field_id makes visit.field_code differ from field.field_code (trivial = transposed digit with same crop, large = code belonging to another crop); visit_date makes the visit date precede a spray dated as already checked; note_target names a different organism in scout_note than observations.target; area_ha puts a different area in notes or spray_history. Mismatches are never flagged. mitigation_present renders by type: beneficials_above_ratio as beneficials counts meeting the threshold_ref.beneficial_rule; within_protection_period as a spray whose date plus protection_days covers the visit; past_susceptible_stage as visit stage beyond threshold_ref.latest_timing_stage; headland_only_sampling as all high counts tagged 'headland' with clean in-field points; harvest_interval_blocks_spray as harvest_interval_days exceeding days to expected harvest, which also sets window_urgency. The same high counts occur with and without mitigation equally often. prior_spray_outcome renders through spray_history: explained failures show rain_within_6h true, rate_pct_label below 100, or application outside the stage window; unexplained failures show full rate, dry, in-window application with outcome_check 'survivors'; reinfestation_likely shows good outcome_check followed by a long gap and fresh counts only at headland points. confirmation_outstanding renders as lab_status 'pending' or a scout_note saying a trap was not downloaded. points_shortfall shows as visit.points_walked below points_required; a large shortfall with borderline counts supports hold_confirm. days_to_window_close is never stated; derive from visit date, latest_timing_stage, drilling date and harvest interval. note_quality: hedged_possible notes use words like 'possibly' or 'could be', making id_supported false; describes_other_target describes symptoms of another organism. spatial_pattern shows in location tags. Decoys: grower_alarm messages ('needs spraying today'), weather fields, variety names, and beneficials counts below the rule. No field may state a disposition, urgency, severity, resistance verdict or identification confidence.

F323.role: Regional apiary health inspector reviewing submitted hive inspection records
F323.setting: A regional bee health service receives inspection records for individual colonies from field inspectors and registered beekeepers. The inspector reads one record at a time. They decide whether notifiable brood disease is actually confirmed, whether the colony is queenright, what follow-up action to issue, and how heavy the varroa burden is. Records combine field observations, mite washes, treatment logs, laboratory submissions and inspection history. These parts often disagree, arrive out of order or are missing.

notifiable_confirmed.instructions: Notifiable foul brood is confirmed by a recorded test result.

criteria.true: Positive lab or field kit result for AFB or EFB
criteria.false: Only symptoms, pending sample, or negative tests recorded

queenright.instructions: Colony is queenright on evidence from the latest inspection.

criteria.true: Queen seen or eggs present at latest inspection
criteria.false: No queen or eggs; only cells, larvae or assumption

next_action.instructions: What follow-up action should the inspector issue for this colony?

criteria.sign_off: No outstanding disease or queen finding; record closed without revisit
criteria.revisit_hold: One finding awaits confirmation; colony rechecked within fourteen days
criteria.treatment_order: Confirmed non-notifiable problem; beekeeper must treat and report back
criteria.standstill_order: Notifiable disease confirmed; apiary movements stopped pending destruction or shook swarm

source_support.instructions: How many independent sources confirm the information in this record?
criteria: No independent source confirms the information
Exactly one independent source confirms it
Two or three independent sources confirm it
Four or more independent sources confirm it

mite_load.instructions: What is the varroa mite load per hundred bees sampled?
criteria: Under 1 mite per 100 bees
1 to under 3 mites per 100 bees
3 to under 6 mites per 100 bees
6 or more mites per 100 bees

factors.name: brood_symptom
factors.description: Brood abnormality recorded at inspection, from none through benign conditions to suspected foul brood signs

factors.name: lab_status
factors.description: State of the laboratory submission for brood samples, including absent and pending

factors.name: field_kit_result
factors.description: Result of the on-site lateral flow test kit, which is indicative only and can disagree with the lab

factors.name: queen_evidence
factors.description: Strongest queen evidence observed at the latest inspection

factors.name: recent_requeen
factors.description: Colony was requeened or a virgin queen introduced within 21 days before inspection, a benign reason for no eggs

factors.name: wash_mites
factors.description: Mites counted in the most recent valid alcohol or sugar wash

factors.name: wash_bees
factors.description: Bees in the wash sample; the load must be computed against this count rather than assumed to be 300

factors.name: treatment_timing
factors.description: Whether a varroa treatment was applied and where it falls relative to the washes

factors.name: benign_brood_explanation
factors.description: A recorded cold snap, colony move or recent split that plausibly explains a scattered or chilled brood pattern

factors.name: missing_part
factors.description: Which required part of the record is null or absent, if any

factors.name: dates_out_of_order
factors.description: A lab result dated before the sample was sent, or a sample sent before the inspection date

factors.name: nearby_outbreak_km
factors.description: Distance to the nearest confirmed foul brood apiary, alarming when close but not proof for this colony

factors.name: prior_positive_count
factors.description: Number of earlier inspections in history with a confirmed disease or a treatment order

sections.name: apiary
sections.description: Apiary identifier, region, hive count, movement plans and distance to nearest confirmed outbreak

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: Inspection date, inspector grade, brood frames, symptom codes, field kit result and queen observations

sections.name: colony_events
sections.description: Requeening, splits, moves and weather events with dates

sections.name: varroa
sections.description: List of wash records and list of treatments, each dated

sections.name: lab
sections.description: Sample identifier, sent date, result code and result date; may be null

sections.name: history
sections.description: List of earlier inspections with date, outcome code and any order issued

F323.rendering_notes: brood_symptom appears as inspection.symptom_codes (a list, possibly empty) plus inspection.brood_frames_affected. lab_status appears as lab.result: null when pending, or the whole lab object null when not sampled. If missing_part is lab_section_null, lab is null even when symptoms suggest a sample was taken. field_kit_result appears as inspection.lfd_result (null when not used). A positive kit with a negative or pending lab must leave notifiable_confirmed contested or false, not true. queen_evidence appears as inspection.queen_seen (bool), eggs_present (bool), open_larvae (bool) and queen_cells_capped (integer). recent_requeen appears as colony_events entries of type requeen or virgin_introduced with a date; the inspector must compare that date with inspection.date. wash_mites and wash_bees appear as varroa.washes[] {date, method, bees_sampled, mites}. Only washes dated after any treatment count. When treatment_timing is after_latest_wash, the latest wash predates treatment and still sets mite_load, but the colony action may soften. A per-100 load is never stated; the reader must compute it, and values near 1, 3 or 6 are deliberate boundary cases. benign_brood_explanation appears as colony_events entries of type cold_night, moved or split near the inspection date. missing_part nulls the named object or fields, or empties history. dates_out_of_order shows as lab.result_date earlier than lab.sent_date, or lab.sent_date earlier than inspection.date, which casts doubt on the result. nearby_outbreak_km appears as apiary.nearest_confirmed_km. prior_positive_count appears as history entries with outcome codes such as efb_confirmed or treatment_ordered. Decoys: apiary.hive_count, inspection.temperament, inspection.stores_frames, inspection.weather_on_day, inspector grade and apiary.movement_planned carry no direct bearing on the answers. No field ever states confirmation, queenright status, recommended action or a mite load figure; answers must be inferred from raw observations, dates and cross-section comparisons.

F324.role: Fertigation supervisor reviewing each greenhouse zone's daily irrigation log before sign-off
F324.setting: A glasshouse vegetable and cut-flower operation runs drip fertigation through many substrate zones. Each morning the fertigation supervisor opens the previous day's log for one zone at a time. A log combines the zone's fixed set-up, the planned schedule, the controller's per-cycle record, drain measurements, sensor readings and the maintenance register. The supervisor must check whether the zone got the water it was meant to get and, if not, why. They then decide whether to sign off, watch, hold, retune or send a technician. Nothing in the log states a verdict. The supervisor must reconcile figures across sections, such as planned against metered volume, dripper counts against per-dripper doses and drain targets against measured drain. They must also weigh alarming readings against approved overrides, maintenance windows and calibration status.

under_dosed.instructions: Zone received materially less water than scheduled across the logged day.

criteria.true: Metered delivery below 90% of plan without approved reduction
criteria.false: Delivery within 10% of plan, or reduction was approved

emitter_clogging.instructions: Emitter clogging is the most likely cause of the shortfall.

criteria.true: Low per-dripper flow with normal pressure and valve opening
criteria.false: Pressure, valve, entry error or no shortfall explains readings

next_action.instructions: What should the supervisor do with this zone's daily log?

criteria.sign_off: All sections reconcile and readings sit within tolerance
criteria.monitor: Small deviation within tolerance edges; recheck at next routine walk
criteria.hold_for_check: One unconfirmed reading blocks a decision until manually verified
criteria.adjust_schedule: Confirmed deviation correctable by changing dose or setpoints only
criteria.dispatch_repair: Confirmed hardware fault needing physical work in the zone

drain_deviation.instructions: How far was measured drain fraction outside its target band?
criteria: In band: drain fraction inside the target band
Slight: outside band by under 5 percentage points
Marked: outside band by 5 to 15 points
Severe: outside band by more than 15 points

off_plan_cycles.instructions: How many cycles delivered volume more than 10% off plan?
criteria: None of the day's cycles outside tolerance
Exactly one cycle outside volume tolerance
Two or three cycles outside volume tolerance
Four or more cycles outside volume tolerance

factors.name: delivery_shortfall_pct
factors.description: True percentage by which metered daily delivery fell short of the planned dose; never shown directly, it must be derived by comparing schedule totals with controller and meter figures

factors.name: mismatch_location
factors.description: Where the cross-section discrepancy hides: no discrepancy, per-cycle sum differs from controller daily total, flow meter total differs from controller total, unit mismatch between mL per dripper and L per zone, or dripper count in zone section differs from the count the schedule assumes

factors.name: fault_cause
factors.description: Underlying cause of any delivery anomaly; shapes the joint pattern of pressure, valve state, per-dripper flow and schedule entries

factors.name: approved_override
factors.description: A grower-approved dose reduction or light-sum skip is logged in the schedule overrides list, which legitimately explains lower delivery

factors.name: maintenance_window_active
factors.description: An acid flush or line purge window overlaps one or more cycles in the maintenance register, explaining abnormal volumes or EC on those cycles

factors.name: drain_offset_points
factors.description: Measured mean drain percentage minus the nearest edge of the target drain band; zero or inside band means no deviation, values near 5 and 15 sit on scale boundaries

factors.name: off_tolerance_cycles
factors.description: Number of cycles whose delivered volume differs from planned by more than 10%, before allowing for maintenance windows or overrides

factors.name: meter_calibration_age_days
factors.description: Days since the zone flow meter was last calibrated; beyond the site interval of 180 days the meter reading is not trusted on its own

factors.name: confirmation_pending
factors.description: A manual drain-cup or dripper catch test has been ordered but its result field is still null

factors.name: pressure_state
factors.description: State of the line pressure readings for the day: within spec, below spec, or missing for some cycles

factors.name: benign_alarm_decoy
factors.description: An alarming-looking but harmless entry: none, low tank alarm acknowledged and cleared, EC spike confined to a flush cycle, or high substrate moisture right after a manual hand-watering

factors.name: recent_work_orders
factors.description: Count of closed work orders on this zone's drip lines in the past 30 days; repeat faults argue for repair over schedule tweaks

sections.name: zone
sections.description: Fixed zone set-up: zone_id, crop, substrate, dripper_count, dripper_rate_lph, valve_id, meter_id

sections.name: schedule
sections.description: Planned day: cycles list with start and planned_ml_per_dripper, drain_target_pct band, ec_target, overrides list

sections.name: controller_log
sections.description: Per-cycle record: start, valve_open_s, delivered_l, line_pressure_bar; plus daily_total_l and meter_total_l

sections.name: drainage
sections.description: Drain measurements: drain_pct per sample, drain_ec, drain_ph, catch_test object with ordered and result

sections.name: sensors
sections.description: Substrate moisture and EC readings with timestamps, meter_last_calibrated date, sensor_status flags

sections.name: maintenance
sections.description: Register entries: windows with type, start and end; alarms with code, acknowledged, cleared; recent_work_orders list

F324.rendering_notes: delivery_shortfall_pct appears only via arithmetic. Compare planned_ml_per_dripper times zone.dripper_count with controller_log.delivered_l per cycle, then daily_total_l and meter_total_l. mismatch_location places a discrepancy in exactly one spot. For cycle_sum_vs_total, the per-cycle delivered_l values do not sum to daily_total_l. For meter_vs_controller, meter_total_l differs from daily_total_l. For unit_mismatch, one cycle's planned value is logged in L where mL is expected, so a naive reading looks like a huge over-dose. For dripper_count_mismatch, zone.dripper_count differs from a dripper_count_assumed field in schedule. When the value is none, everything reconciles to within 1%. fault_cause is never named. Emitter_clogging shows as normal line_pressure_bar and full valve_open_s but low delivered_l per dripper and low drain_pct. Low_supply_pressure shows as line_pressure_bar below spec_bar. Valve_fault shows as valve_open_s short of planned duration. Sensor_drift shows as a meter disagreeing with catch_test or moisture trends while the controller looks normal. Schedule_entry_error shows as one cycle's planned_ml out of line with its siblings. approved_override appears as an entry in schedule.overrides with approved_by_role and reduction_pct; when it is false the overrides list is empty or holds an unrelated past-dated entry as a decoy. maintenance_window_active appears as a maintenance.windows entry whose time range overlaps specific cycle start times; some decoy windows fall on other dates or other zones. drain_offset_points sets drainage.drain_pct samples against schedule.drain_target_pct min and max; the reader computes the mean and the distance to the band. off_tolerance_cycles is the count of cycles whose delivered differs from planned by over 10%, and it must be counted. Cycles inside a maintenance window still count toward the score question, though they mitigate the action and the true/false questions. meter_calibration_age_days is shown as sensors.meter_last_calibrated, an ISO date alongside the log date, with no age field. confirmation_pending shows as drainage.catch_test.ordered true and result null. pressure_state partly_missing renders as null line_pressure_bar on some cycles. benign_alarm_decoy places an alarm with acknowledged and cleared true, an EC spike timed inside a flush window, or a moisture spike preceded by a hand-water event. recent_work_orders lists closed orders with dates, some older than 30 days as decoys. No field may state shortfall, cause, deviation level, cycle-fault count, urgency or recommended action. The only status-like fields are those a real controller shows: alarm codes, acknowledged and cleared flags, and sensor_status ok/stale. Numbers are numbers, dates are ISO, unknowns are null, and there are no free-text fields.

F325.role: Site water quality supervisor at a marine finfish farm, reviewing each pen's logged water check one record at a time and deciding whether the reading is trustworthy, what caused any deviation and what the pen team should do next.
F325.setting: A sea-loch salmon and trout farm runs scheduled water checks on every pen several times a day. A technician takes a handheld probe profile, the pen's fixed logger keeps its own trace, and the shift supervisor signs the check off. Each record pulls together the pen's stocking and limits, the check readings, the instrument and calibration details, site conditions, the last seven checks and short free-text notes from the sampler and feed team. The supervisor must decide from these sections, which often disagree, whether the pen has a real problem and how to respond.

genuine_do_breach.instructions: Dissolved oxygen in the pen genuinely fell below its welfare threshold.

next_step.instructions: What should the site team do with this pen next?

criteria.file_routine: Readings valid and within limits; keep normal check schedule.
criteria.resample_first: Validity in doubt; repeat check with calibrated probe before acting.
criteria.reduce_feeding: Valid mild deficit; cut feed and recheck within the shift.
criteria.start_oxygenation: Valid serious deficit; start supplementary oxygen and alert manager.

deviation_cause.instructions: What most likely explains the main deviation recorded at this pen?

criteria.no_deviation: All valid readings sit within the pen's set limits.
criteria.instrument_fault: Probe failed, overdue or disagrees with the fixed logger.
criteria.recording_error: Value mistyped, wrong unit or mismatched between record sections.
criteria.environmental_event: Bloom, warm water, slack tide or storm drives the change.
criteria.husbandry_load: Feeding, crowding, treatment or biomass level drives the change.

persistence.instructions: How persistent is the out-of-range condition across the last seven checks?
criteria: None: no checks out of range in last seven
Single: exactly one of last seven checks out of range
Recurring: two or three of last seven out of range
Sustained: four or more of last seven out of range

evidence_completeness.instructions: How complete is the required evidence behind this water check?
criteria: Three or more required elements missing or invalid
Exactly two required elements missing or invalid
Exactly one required element missing or invalid
Every required element present, valid and correctly dated

factors.name: stock_stage
factors.description: Life stage of the fish in the pen, which sets the dissolved oxygen and ammonia limits stored in the pen section (smolt strictest, broodstock next, grower and harvest-size least strict).

factors.name: true_do_margin
factors.description: Actual dissolved oxygen minus the pen's minimum, in mg/L; negative means a real deficit. Under -2 counts as serious, -2 to 0 as mild.

factors.name: primary_cause
factors.description: The single underlying driver of whatever looks abnormal in the record, or none when nothing is genuinely abnormal.

factors.name: cross_section_mismatch
factors.description: Kind of disagreement between corresponding values in different sections: probe reading vs logger trace, unit vs pen limit unit, value in note vs value in readings, pen id in check vs pen section.

factors.name: calibration_state
factors.description: Status of the handheld probe's calibration relative to the sample time: current, past due date, failed last calibration, or calibration block absent.

factors.name: logger_alarm_raised
factors.description: Whether the fixed pen logger raised a low-oxygen or high-ammonia alarm flag around the check time; an alarming signal that is often not decisive on its own.

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: Whether a field in the record lowers concern about the alarming signal; sampled independently of the alarm so the alarm appears with and without mitigation about equally.

factors.name: mitigation_kind
factors.description: Form the mitigation takes when present: aeration already running, an approved bath-treatment window with expected oxygen dip, a documented slack-tide sample timing, or a passed repeat check shortly after.

factors.name: history_out_of_range
factors.description: Number of the last seven checks (including the current one) in which any core parameter was outside the pen's limits.

factors.name: missing_required
factors.description: Count of required elements missing, null or invalid: sampler id, depth profile, valid calibration, supervisor sign-off, full set of core parameters.

factors.name: date_order_fault
factors.description: Whether a timestamp shows a step out of order, such as calibration logged after the sample or sign-off before sampling; the affected element counts as invalid.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Whether a deciding value sits on a scale edge: oxygen within 0.1 mg/L of the minimum, history count at the 1/2 or 3/4 boundary, or mitigation and alarm evenly balanced.

factors.name: note_tone
factors.description: How the free-text notes relate to the data: neutral, alarming wording with a benign explanation, reassuring wording contradicted by readings, or concern consistent with readings.

sections.name: pen
sections.description: Pen identity, species, life stage, biomass, stocking density and the set limits for oxygen, ammonia and temperature.

sections.name: check
sections.description: The current check: pen id, sampled_at, sampler_id, depth profile list and core readings with units.

sections.name: instrument
sections.description: Probe serial, last calibration date and result, cal_due date, and the fixed logger's trace and alarm flags.

sections.name: conditions
sections.description: Site context: tide state, water temperature trend, algal advisory, weather, active treatment or aeration windows, recent feeding.

sections.name: history
sections.description: List of the previous six checks with date, lowest oxygen, ammonia and an in_limits boolean.

sections.name: notes
sections.description: Short free-text lines from the sampler, the feed team and the supervisor sign-off.

F325.rendering_notes: stock_stage appears as pen.stage with limits in pen.limits (do_min_mg_l, tan_max_mg_l, temp_max_c); the reader must compare readings to these limits, never a computed pass/fail. true_do_margin drives check.readings.do_mg_l and check.depth_profile (list of {depth_m, do_mg_l}); the lowest valid depth reading is the one that counts. primary_cause is never stated: instrument shows via instrument.cal_result 'fail', cal_due before sampled_at, or probe vs instrument.logger_do_mg_l gap over 1 mg/L; recording shows via cross_section_mismatch; environmental via conditions.algal_advisory, conditions.temp_trend_c_24h or conditions.tide 'slack_low'; husbandry via pen.density_kg_m3 high, conditions.feed_kg_last_6h above usual, or a treatment entry. cross_section_mismatch: rounding_only differs by under 0.2 mg/L between probe and note (trivial, ignore); unit_confusion records do as '%sat' in check.readings.do_unit while limits are mg/L; large_transcription puts one value in notes.sampler and a different one in check.readings; pen_id_mismatch has check.pen_id differing from pen.pen_id by one character. calibration_state lives in instrument.last_cal (date), instrument.cal_result and instrument.cal_due; absent sets instrument.last_cal to null. logger_alarm_raised appears as instrument.logger_flags list containing 'LOW_DO' or 'HIGH_TAN'; this is a decoy unless readings and calibration back it. mitigation_present and mitigation_kind show in conditions (aeration.active true with started_at before sample, treatment_window with approved_by and expected_do_dip_mg_l, tide 'slack_low' with note of sample timing) or as history entry/notes line recording a passed repeat check within two hours. history_out_of_range is shown only as six history items each with in_limits boolean plus the current check, which the reader must judge against limits; never total it. missing_required renders as null or absent fields (check.sampler_id null, check.depth_profile empty, notes.signoff null, a core reading null, instrument block missing). date_order_fault renders as instrument.last_cal later than check.sampled_at, or notes.signoff_at earlier than sampled_at. boundary_case sets the lowest oxygen within 0.1 mg/L of do_min, or history at a band edge, or pairs alarm with mitigation of matching weight. note_tone shapes notes.sampler and notes.feed_team one-sentence lines, e.g. 'fish sluggish at feed' alongside a recent grading entry, or 'all fine, good oxygen' beside a low reading. Decoys: logger_flags, alarming note wording, rounding-only differences, a prior out-of-range day explained in history. No field may hold a risk level, verdict, cause label, recommended action or completeness score.

F326.role: Local planning authority tree officer determining applications for works to protected trees
F326.setting: A district council's arboricultural team receives applications to fell, reduce or prune trees covered by tree preservation orders. The tree officer opens one application record at a time, compares the applicant's tree schedule with the order register entry and the submitted arboricultural report, checks site constraints and the property's enforcement history, and decides on the evidence, the decision to issue, the inspection priority and the extent of works proposed.

evidence_supports_works.instructions: Current arboricultural evidence supports the full extent of works applied for.

criteria.true: Recent report recommends works at least this extensive
criteria.false: Report absent, stale, or recommends lighter works

decision.instructions: What decision should be issued on this application?

criteria.refuse: Works unjustified or harmful to amenity; consent withheld entirely
criteria.request_info: Decision held pending one missing or out-of-date item
criteria.grant_conditional: Works acceptable only if scaled back or made subject to conditions
criteria.grant_as_applied: Works justified as submitted; consent issued without any changes

inspection_priority.instructions: How quickly should an officer site inspection be scheduled?

criteria.standard_queue: No hazard reported; determination deadline over four weeks away
criteria.schedule_soon: No hazard reported; determination deadline two to four weeks away
criteria.expedite: Deadline under two weeks, or hazard already made safe
criteria.emergency_visit: Highway or imminent-failure hazard reported with no interim safety measures

affected_scope.instructions: How many people or units does this issue directly affect?
criteria: Affects one person or unit only
Affects two to five people or units
Affects six to twenty people or units
Affects more than twenty people or units

works_extent.instructions: What is the greatest extent of works proposed on any tree?
criteria: Deadwood removal, cleaning or crown lift only
Crown reduction of 1 to 20 percent
Crown reduction of 21 to 30 percent
Reduction above 30 percent, or felling

factors.name: order_coverage
factors.description: Whether the trees listed in the application all appear in the order register entry; some listed trees may be absent or only covered by an area designation

factors.name: schedule_report_discrepancy
factors.description: Mismatch between the applicant's tree schedule and the arboricultural report for the same tree: none, stem diameter differs slightly, species differs, or report recommends lighter works than applied for

factors.name: condition_grade
factors.description: Arboricultural condition grade of the principal tree as recorded in the report

factors.name: max_reduction_pct
factors.description: Largest crown reduction proposed on any tree in the schedule; 0 means minor pruning only, 100 means felling; values cluster near 20 and 30 for boundary cases

factors.name: damage_claim
factors.description: Applicant cites subsidence or structural damage to a building attributed to the tree

factors.name: engineer_evidence
factors.description: Structural engineer's monitoring and root identification confirming tree involvement; present for roughly half of damage claims, absent otherwise

factors.name: bat_roost_potential
factors.description: Report or constraints layer flags features with potential to support roosting bats

factors.name: ecology_survey_clear
factors.description: A dated emergence survey found no roost, lowering concern about the bat flag

factors.name: prior_contraventions
factors.description: Number of recorded unauthorised works to protected trees at the property

factors.name: contravention_resolved
factors.description: Replacement planting required after a past contravention has been verified as completed

factors.name: report_age_months
factors.description: Months between the arboricultural survey date and the application received date; over 12 counts as stale

factors.name: days_to_deadline
factors.description: Days between today's review date and the statutory determination date

factors.name: reported_hazard
factors.description: Hazard condition noted in the report or site constraints

factors.name: interim_measures
factors.description: Cordon, propping or emergency limb removal already in place, making a reported hazard safe

sections.name: application
sections.description: Reference, received date, determination date, review date, applicant type, cited grounds codes

sections.name: tree_schedule
sections.description: List of trees applied for: applicant tree id, species, dbh_cm, works code, reduction_pct

sections.name: order_register
sections.description: Order reference, confirmed flag, designation type, list of protected tree ids with species and dbh_cm

sections.name: arb_report
sections.description: Survey date, per-tree condition grade, dbh_cm, recommended works and reduction_pct, hazard code, bat features flag

sections.name: site_constraints
sections.description: Conservation area flag, highway adjacency, ecology survey record, interim measures, engineer monitoring record

sections.name: case_history
sections.description: Prior applications count, contraventions list with dates and replanting verification status

F326.rendering_notes: order_coverage: compare tree_schedule ids and species with order_register.trees; one_tree_absent shows a schedule id missing from the register list; area_designation_only shows designation 'area' with an empty trees list; order_ref_wrong shows application.order_ref differing from order_register.order_ref by a digit. schedule_report_discrepancy: same tree id carries different dbh_cm (under 10%), species, or a lower reduction_pct or lighter works code in arb_report than in tree_schedule; never flagged. condition_grade appears only in arb_report.trees[].condition. max_reduction_pct appears as tree_schedule[].reduction_pct, with works code 'fell' for 100 and 'deadwood'/'lift' for 0. damage_claim appears as grounds code 'SUBS' in application.grounds; engineer_evidence as site_constraints.engineer_monitoring object with months_monitored and roots_identified, or null. bat_roost_potential as arb_report.bat_features true; ecology_survey_clear as site_constraints.ecology_survey with date and roost_found false, or null. prior_contraventions as case_history.contraventions list; contravention_resolved as replant_verified true/false per item. report_age_months is derived from arb_report.survey_date versus application.received; days_to_deadline from application.review_date versus application.determination_due. reported_hazard as arb_report hazard code plus site_constraints.highway_adjacent; interim_measures as site_constraints.interim_measures list (cordon, prop) or empty. Decoys: order_register.confirmed false (a provisional order still protects), conservation_area flag (irrelevant when the order applies), prior_applications count (approved applications are not contraventions), minor_deadwood hazard code, small dbh differences. No record may contain a recommendation, priority, risk rating, justified flag or decision field; the report gives only measurements, grades and recommended works.

F327.role: Bookings officer for a charitable village hall trust, reviewing each hire request before it is confirmed, held or turned away
F327.setting: A small hall trust runs a main hall, a committee room and a kitchen annexe for private parties, clubs, classes and fundraisers. Requests arrive through an online form that builds a structured record from the applicant's account, the event details, the requested slot, uploaded documents, payment ledger and past hire history. The officer works through one request at a time, decides what happens to it, what staffing the hall must provide on the day, and how complete and well-sized it is. Records hold no free text; every judgement rests on fields, dates, counts and cross-section comparisons.

cover_valid.instructions: Public liability cover is in force for the whole event date.

disposition.instructions: What should the bookings officer do with this request?

criteria.decline: Unresolved arrears or unsettled damage claim bars this hirer outright.
criteria.hold_for_docs: Hirer eligible and slot free, but required documents incomplete.
criteria.offer_alternative: Hirer eligible but requested slot clashes with a firm booking.
criteria.approve_conditional: Slot free, documents supplied; approval needs caps, staffing or verification.
criteria.approve: Slot free, documents verified, no caps or extra staffing required.

supervision.instructions: What level of caretaker presence should the hall arrange?

criteria.self_access: Trusted regular hirer collects key; no staff attend at all.
criteria.open_and_lock: Caretaker unlocks and locks up only; no cover during event.
criteria.on_call: Caretaker reachable by phone, able to attend within minutes.
criteria.on_site: Caretaker remains on the premises for the whole hire.

doc_completeness.instructions: How complete is the required documentation for this event?
criteria: None: no required document has been uploaded.
Partial: some uploaded, at least one absent or expired.
Unverified: all uploaded and in date, one or more unverified.
Complete: all uploaded, in date and office-verified.

attendance_load.instructions: How does expected attendance compare with the room's capacity?
criteria: Attendance below half of room capacity
Attendance from half to under 80% of capacity
Attendance from 80% up to full capacity
Attendance above capacity by no more than 10%
Attendance exceeds capacity by more than 10%

factors.name: event_type
factors.description: Kind of hire; drives which documents are required (alcohol authorisation, safeguarding policy, food hygiene certificate) and the baseline staffing need.

factors.name: attendance_ratio
factors.description: Expected attendance divided by the capacity of the requested room; about a fifth of records sit within two percentage points of 50%, 80%, 100% or 110% so judges may split.

factors.name: insurance_state
factors.description: Source and validity of public liability cover: own certificate valid, own certificate expiring before the event, no certificate, hall hirer scheme opted into with premium paid, or opted in but premium unpaid.

factors.name: other_docs_missing
factors.description: Number of required non-insurance documents (alcohol authorisation, safeguarding policy, food hygiene certificate) absent, null-dated or expired before the event; capped by how many the event actually requires.

factors.name: docs_unverified
factors.description: At least one uploaded, in-date document has verified_on null, meaning the office has not yet checked it.

factors.name: verification_out_of_order
factors.description: A document's verified_on date precedes its uploaded_on date, or the deposit_paid_on precedes request_received; an out-of-order verification must be treated as unverified.

factors.name: slot_clash
factors.description: Overlap with another booking in the same room and time window: none, firm (confirmed) clash, provisional clash whose hold has already expired, or provisional clash still live.

factors.name: hirer_track_record
factors.description: Applicant's history with the hall: first-time hirer, regular hirer with no incidents, or regular hirer with at least one recorded damage or overstay incident.

factors.name: incident_settled
factors.description: Mitigation for a past incident: the damage claim has a settled_on date before the request date. Only meaningful when the hirer has an incident.

factors.name: arrears_state
factors.description: Overdue balance on the hirer's account: none, overdue with no plan, or overdue with an agreed payment plan and no missed instalments.

factors.name: alcohol_late_finish
factors.description: Whether alcohol is served and whether the event ends after 23:00, the hall's standard closing time.

factors.name: external_bar_staffed
factors.description: Mitigation for alcohol: an external licensed bar operator supplies its own staff (staff_count at least 2). Only meaningful when alcohol is served.

factors.name: days_to_event
factors.description: Days between request_received and the event date; short lead times make an unverified document harder to resolve and appear as decoy urgency.

sections.name: applicant
sections.description: Hirer account: id, hirer_type, first_booking_date, hirer_scheme_opt_in.

sections.name: event
sections.description: Event details: category, expected_attendance, alcohol_served, bar_operator, finish_time, under_18s_present, catering.

sections.name: booking_slot
sections.description: Requested room, room_capacity, date, start, end, request_received and a clashes list.

sections.name: documents
sections.description: List of uploaded documents with doc_type, uploaded_on, expires_on, verified_on.

sections.name: payment
sections.description: hire_fee, deposit_due, deposit_paid_on, overdue_balance, payment_plan, scheme_premium_paid.

sections.name: history
sections.description: past_bookings_count and an incidents list with date, type, claim_amount, settled_on.

F327.rendering_notes: event_type shows as event.category plus derived flags (under_18s_present true for children_party; catering 'hot_food' for some celebrations and fundraisers; alcohol_served from alcohol_late_finish). attendance_ratio is never shown; render event.expected_attendance and booking_slot.room_capacity as integers so the reader must divide. insurance_state appears as a documents entry of doc_type 'public_liability' (expires_on before booking_slot.date when expiring; entry absent when missing) or, for scheme cases, applicant.hirer_scheme_opt_in true with payment.scheme_premium_paid true or false and no certificate entry. cover_valid is true only for own_cert_valid or hall_scheme_paid. Required non-insurance documents are not listed anywhere: the reader infers them (alcohol_authorisation if alcohol_served and bar_operator.type is 'self'; safeguarding_policy if under_18s_present; food_hygiene if catering is 'hot_food'); other_docs_missing renders as an absent entry, an entry with uploaded_on null, or expires_on before the event. docs_unverified renders as verified_on null; verification_out_of_order renders as verified_on earlier than uploaded_on, or deposit_paid_on earlier than request_received (a ledger decoy that does not by itself change disposition). slot_clash renders in booking_slot.clashes as entries with status 'confirmed' or 'provisional' and hold_expires; a lapsed provisional has hold_expires before request_received and does not block the slot; a live provisional is contested between hold and offer_alternative. Clashes on the same date but non-overlapping times are decoys. hirer_track_record renders via history.past_bookings_count (0 for first-time, with applicant.first_booking_date null) and history.incidents; incident_settled renders as settled_on date or null. arrears_state renders as payment.overdue_balance above 0 with payment_plan null or a plan object (agreed_on, instalments_missed 0). alcohol_late_finish renders via event.alcohol_served and event.finish_time; external_bar_staffed via event.bar_operator {type:'external', staff_count}. days_to_event is implied by request_received and booking_slot.date. Disposition precedence: unresolved arrears or unsettled incident claim gives decline; else firm or live clash gives offer_alternative; else any missing or expired document gives hold_for_docs; else unverified documents, attendance above capacity, or alcohol/late finish needing on_site or on_call staffing gives approve_conditional; otherwise approve. Supervision: on_site for both alcohol and late finish without external staffed bar, attendance above capacity, or unsettled incident; on_call for alcohol or late finish mitigated by external staff, or first-time hirer at 80% or more of capacity; self_access only for regular_clean hirers with neither alcohol nor late finish and attendance under 80%; open_and_lock otherwise. Decoys: hirer_type, hire_fee size, large past_bookings_count alongside an unsettled incident, room name, short lead time. No record may carry fields such as status, risk, recommended_action, docs_complete, supervision_level or capacity_percentage.

F328.role: Fleet driver safety coach at a regional haulage operator, reviewing one vehicle-week telematics driving report at a time
F328.setting: Each week the depot's telematics platform produces a driving report per vehicle and assigned driver. The coach checks flagged speed, harsh-handling and driving-hours events against trip logs, digital tachograph entries, device health and supervisor notes. The coach decides whether the flags are genuine, what caused the worst event, how serious the speed and hours exposure is, and what follow-up to arrange. Many flags are softened or explained by other parts of the record, such as stale map limits, logged roadworks, card swaps, double-manned shifts or device faults.

driver_attributed.instructions: The reported driver was at the wheel during flagged speed events.

criteria.true: Card, trip and tacho records place this driver there.
criteria.false: Another card, an unlogged swap, or no linking evidence.

follow_up.instructions: What follow-up should the coach arrange for this driver?

criteria.no_action: No confirmed breach remains once exceptions and faults are applied.
criteria.hold_verify: A possible breach hinges on one unconfirmed record or claim.
criteria.coaching: Confirmed breach, and no completed coaching on the same issue.
criteria.formal_review: Serious breach, or confirmed breach recurring after completed coaching.

worst_event_cause.instructions: What best explains the most significant flagged event in this report?

criteria.driver_choice: Driver behaviour, with no supporting external or technical explanation.
criteria.road_conditions: Logged traffic, weather or roadworks context accounts for the event.
criteria.map_data: Posted limit on the event conflicts with a newer limit record.
criteria.device_fault: Device health or calibration issue makes the reading unreliable.

speed_excess.instructions: How far over the posted limit was the worst unmitigated speed event?
criteria: No unmitigated event above the posted limit
Worst unmitigated event under 10% over limit
Worst unmitigated event 10% to 20% over limit
Worst unmitigated event more than 20% over limit

hours_exposure.instructions: How long was the longest driving stint without a qualifying break?
criteria: Clear: longest unbroken stint under three hours
Close: unbroken stint from three to 4.5 hours
Breach: unbroken stint over 4.5, up to 5.5 hours
Serious: unbroken stint longer than 5.5 hours

factors.name: driver_assignment
factors.description: Whether the driver named in report_meta matches the driver cards on trips and the tachograph at flagged event times.

factors.name: raw_speed_excess_pct
factors.description: Percentage by which the worst recorded speed exceeds the posted limit attached to that event, before any mitigation.

factors.name: speed_mitigation
factors.description: Whether the worst speed event has a mitigating explanation elsewhere in the record.

factors.name: harsh_event_count
factors.description: Number of harsh braking, acceleration and cornering events flagged in the period.

factors.name: harsh_context_logged
factors.description: Whether the harsh events cluster at times and places carrying a congestion, weather or roadworks tag.

factors.name: device_health
factors.description: Condition of the telematics unit during the period.

factors.name: telematics_stint_hours
factors.description: Longest continuous ignition-on driving stint according to the trip log.

factors.name: tacho_break_reconciles
factors.description: Whether the tachograph records a qualifying break or a driver changeover inside the telematics stint, shortening the real unbroken stint.

factors.name: prior_coaching_count
factors.description: Number of completed coaching sessions on the same issue in the last 12 months.

factors.name: coaching_status
factors.description: State of any coaching already raised for the current issue.

factors.name: boundary_value
factors.description: Whether a deciding value is placed exactly on a scale threshold, such as 10.0% over the limit, a 3.0 or 4.5 hour stint, or a break of exactly 45 minutes.

factors.name: note_content
factors.description: What the supervisor note or driver comment asserts about the flagged events.

factors.name: distance_discrepancy_pct
factors.description: Gap between odometer distance and summed GPS trip distance. Mostly a decoy; large values hint at a device fault.

sections.name: report_meta
sections.description: Report id, period start and end dates, vehicle registration, assigned driver id, depot.

sections.name: vehicle_device
sections.description: Unit serial, firmware, last calibration date, health flags, odometer start and end.

sections.name: trips
sections.description: List of trips with start and end timestamps, gps_km, driver_card id and ignition-on minutes.

sections.name: events
sections.description: List of flagged speed and harsh events with time, type, recorded_mph, posted_limit_mph, map_ver and context tags.

sections.name: tacho_summary
sections.description: Driver card entries with drive and break intervals, plus any second driver on shift.

sections.name: notes_history
sections.description: Free-text supervisor_note and driver_comment, coaching record list, limit_updates list.

F328.rendering_notes: driver_assignment shows only as a comparison: report_meta.driver_id against trips[].driver_card and tacho_summary card entries at event times. A swap appears as a tacho card change with a logged swap time. A second driver appears as tacho_summary.second_driver. An unexplained mismatch has a different card with no swap entry. card_missing leaves driver_card null. raw_speed_excess_pct is never stated; it must be computed from events[].recorded_mph against posted_limit_mph. speed_mitigation map_limit_outdated appears as notes_history.limit_updates holding a newer limit for the same road segment with a date before the event, while events[].map_ver is older. temp_limit_ended shows a roadworks tag whose end date precedes the event, so the posted 50 should have reverted to 70. emergency_diversion_logged appears as a dated diversion line in supervisor_note. The coach must apply these to find the worst unmitigated event; roughly half of records with a high raw excess carry a mitigation. harsh_event_count is the length of the harsh entries in events. harsh_context_logged adds congestion, weather or roadworks tags to those entries. device_health appears in vehicle_device.health_flags and last_calibration date; a recalibration dated mid-period casts doubt on earlier harsh readings only. GPS drift may also show as an implausible gps_km. distance_discrepancy_pct appears as odometer end minus start against summed trips[].gps_km; small gaps are decoys. telematics_stint_hours is derived from consecutive trips separated by short stops. tacho_break_reconciles appears as a break of 45 minutes or more, or a driver changeover, in tacho_summary inside that span, which the coach must line up by timestamp. boundary_value puts excess at exactly 10.0%, or stints and breaks exactly on 3.0 h, 4.5 h or 45 min. prior_coaching_count and coaching_status appear in the notes_history coaching record list with dates and status (scheduled, partly_completed with modules done of total, completed). note_content is one or two sentences: either a claim backed by a tag or limit update elsewhere, an assertion with no supporting field, or a statement contradicting the event times. Decoys: firmware version, depot name, small odometer gaps, high harsh counts that carry context tags, and a speeding event on a trip driven by another card. The record never contains a driver score, risk rating, severity, cause label, breach flag or recommended action, and never states the unbroken stint length or the excess percentage directly.

F329.role: Application screener in an in-house recruitment team, reviewing one candidate application at a time against its job requisition before shortlisting
F329.setting: A mid-sized employer's applicant tracking system holds each application as a structured record. It contains the requisition's mandatory requirements, the applicant's declared details, their employment history and qualifications, and the state of pre-screen checks: right to work, references and skills assessment. The screener must decide whether the application meets the requisition, whether the applicant's claims hold together across sections, and what happens next. Records arrive at varying levels of completeness: checks may be pending, sections may be null, and dates may fall out of order.

meets_mandatory.instructions: Applicant meets every mandatory requirement stated on the requisition.

criteria.true: Every mandatory requirement is evidenced as met.
criteria.false: At least one requirement is unmet or unevidenced.

experience_consistent.instructions: Claimed total experience matches the sum of listed employment periods.

next_step.instructions: What should happen next with this application at screening?

criteria.reject: A mandatory requirement is evidenced as unmet in the record.
criteria.hold: A mandatory requirement cannot be confirmed; information is missing or conflicting.
criteria.conditional_shortlist: All mandatory requirements met; some required checks are still outstanding.
criteria.shortlist: All mandatory requirements met and every required check completed.

discrepancy_count.instructions: How many cross-section discrepancies does this application record contain?
criteria: None: no corresponding value differs between any sections
One: exactly one corresponding value differs between sections
Two: exactly two corresponding values differ across sections
Many: three or more corresponding values differ across sections

pending_age.instructions: How long has this record been waiting without any decision?
criteria: Logged less than 24 hours ago
Waiting between one and seven days
Waiting between eight and thirty days
Waiting more than thirty days without decision

factors.name: mandatory_req_status
factors.description: Whether the applicant meets the requisition's mandatory requirements (minimum experience, qualification level, licence): all met, one clearly unmet, or one that cannot be confirmed from the record

factors.name: experience_gap_months
factors.description: Difference in months between applicant.claimed_experience_years and the summed employment_history periods; within plus or minus 3 months counts as matching, and values of 3 to 5 months sit on the boundary

factors.name: history_date_error
factors.description: An employment_history entry has an end date before its start date, or a role starts after the application's submitted_at

factors.name: qualification_conflict
factors.description: How the applicant's declared highest qualification compares with the qualifications list: consistent, a title wording variant (decoy), a conflicting award year, or a listed level below the declared one

factors.name: equivalent_experience_waiver
factors.description: Requisition accepts equivalent experience in lieu of the minimum qualification level; this mitigates a lower qualification only when experience comfortably exceeds the minimum

factors.name: rtw_check_state
factors.description: State of the right-to-work check: verified, pending, section null, or verified against a document that expires before the requisition start date

factors.name: references_received
factors.description: Number of references received, compared with requisition.references_required (always 2)

factors.name: assessment_status
factors.description: Skills assessment state: not required by the requisition, passed, scored below the cutoff, scheduled for a future date, or required but never taken

factors.name: identity_mismatch
factors.description: Applicant identifiers compared with those in the screening checks: none, a name capitalisation or order variant (decoy), a different email, or a different date of birth

factors.name: req_ref_mismatch
factors.description: application_meta.req_id_ref differs from requisition.req_id, for example after a reposted vacancy

factors.name: submission_timing
factors.description: Submission relative to the closing date: on time, after closing with a recorded extension, or after closing without one

factors.name: prior_applications
factors.description: Count of earlier applications by the same applicant; a decoy with no bearing on eligibility

sections.name: requisition
sections.description: Vacancy details: req_id, role_title, closing_date, start_date, mandatory requirements, references_required, assessment_required, equivalent_experience_accepted

sections.name: applicant
sections.description: Declared details: applicant_id, full_name, email, dob, claimed_experience_years, declared_qual_level, licence_held

sections.name: employment_history
sections.description: List of roles with employer_ref, title, start, end (null when current)

sections.name: qualifications
sections.description: List of awards with title, level, awarded_year, verified boolean

sections.name: screening_checks
sections.description: Pre-screen checks: rtw object, references object, assessment object; any may be null

sections.name: application_meta
sections.description: Process data: req_id_ref, submitted_at, stage_entered_at, source, prior_applications, closing_extension_granted

F329.rendering_notes: Use numbers as numbers, ISO dates throughout, null for unknown values, and no free-text fields. mandatory_req_status shows only indirectly: requisition.mandatory holds min_experience_years, min_qual_level (integer 2-7) and licence_required. 'one_unmet' is rendered as the history sum, the qualifications list level or applicant.licence_held clearly falling short. 'one_unevidenced' is rendered as licence_held null, or as the only qualification at the required level having verified false. experience_gap_months is rendered as claimed_experience_years with one decimal place against history periods the reader must sum; current roles run to submitted_at. history_date_error puts an end date before its start date, or a start date after submitted_at. qualification_conflict compares applicant.declared_qual_level with the qualifications list. The title_variant decoy, such as 'BSc Logistics' against 'Bachelor of Science (Logistics)', is not a discrepancy. equivalent_experience_waiver appears as requisition.equivalent_experience_accepted. rtw_check_state is rendered in screening_checks.rtw.status and doc_expiry against requisition.start_date; section_missing sets rtw to null. references_received is rendered as screening_checks.references.received alongside requisition.references_required. assessment_status is rendered through assessment.status, score, cutoff and scheduled_for, gated by requisition.assessment_required. identity_mismatch compares applicant email and dob with rtw.email_on_file and rtw.dob_on_file. A name_format_variant, such as a different case or surname first, is a decoy and not a discrepancy. req_ref_mismatch is rendered as application_meta.req_id_ref differing from requisition.req_id. submission_timing compares submitted_at with closing_date and closing_extension_granted. prior_applications is a pure decoy. For discrepancy_count, count only these: an experience gap beyond 3 months, a qualification year conflict, a qualification level conflict, a differing email, a differing dob, a req_id mismatch and an rtw doc_expiry before start_date. Never include fields such as eligible, recommendation, discrepancies, risk or shortlist_status. stage_entered_at supports the shared pending_age scale and must not imply any decision.

F330.role: Travel and expense policy exceptions reviewer in group finance
F330.setting: A mid-sized engineering consultancy routes every expense claim that breaches a policy cap to a central reviewer. The reviewer opens one exception request at a time. Each request bundles the claim header, the itemised lines, the applicable policy limit, the trip and booking context, the approvals held and the employee's recent exception history. The reviewer decides whether the case is covered, why the overspend arose, how large it is, how clean the paperwork is, and what happens to the excess.

preapproval_covers.instructions: A valid pre-approval covers this trip and the full excess.

outside_control.instructions: The overspend resulted from documented circumstances outside the employee's control.

criteria.true: Disruption or no compliant option is recorded in the record
criteria.false: Cause undocumented, or a compliant option was available

excess_disposition.instructions: What should happen to the excess above the policy cap?

criteria.decline_excess: Reimburse only up to the cap; refuse the whole excess.
criteria.partial_approve: Reimburse the cap plus a defined portion of the excess.
criteria.hold_for_info: Pause until one named missing document or approval arrives.
criteria.approve_full: Reimburse the full claimed excess within reviewer sign-off limit.
criteria.refer_controller: Excess merits approval but exceeds reviewer limit; controller decides.

excess_size.instructions: How far does the reconciled claim exceed the policy cap?
criteria: No excess once lines are reconciled to cap
Excess above zero and up to 10% of cap
Excess above 10% and up to 50% of cap
Excess above 50% of the applicable cap

discrepancy_count.instructions: How many cross-section discrepancies does the request contain?
criteria: None: every corresponding value agrees across all sections
Single: exactly one corresponding value disagrees between sections
Pair: exactly two corresponding values disagree
Several: three or four corresponding values disagree
Pervasive: five or more corresponding values disagree

factors.name: breach_type
factors.description: Which policy rule the claim breaches. This sets which lines, caps and supporting items matter.

factors.name: true_excess_pct
factors.description: Actual excess of the reconciled line total in GBP over cap_gbp x units, as a percentage of the cap. About a fifth of records sit within 2 points of the 10% or 50% boundaries.

factors.name: amount_mismatch
factors.description: How request.requested_total relates to the sum of lines.amount_gbp. Values: agreement, a rounding gap under 1 GBP, a stale fx_rate on one line, a line duplicated with the same date and amount, or a large unexplained gap.

factors.name: reference_mismatch
factors.description: Disagreement in dates or identifiers between sections. Values: a line dated outside the travel window, trip_ref differing between request and travel, or a line cost_centre differing from the request.

factors.name: pre_approval_state
factors.description: State of the pre-approval in the approvals section. Values: absent, valid and matching, expired before travel, issued for a different trip_ref, or capped below the claimed excess. The record looks reassuring in all but the valid case only on close comparison.

factors.name: external_disruption
factors.description: Whether the travel feed records a disruption such as a cancellation, diversion or venue change. This mitigates an overspend that otherwise looks discretionary.

factors.name: compliant_option
factors.description: Whether the alternatives check found a within-policy option at booking time. Values: one was available, none was available, or no check was logged.

factors.name: missing_item
factors.description: Single required supporting item absent from the record, if any. The attendee list applies only to entertainment.

factors.name: excess_vs_authority
factors.description: Excess amount in GBP relative to policy.reviewer_limit_gbp. Near_limit cases sit within 5% either side of the limit.

factors.name: client_rechargeable
factors.description: Whether the trip is billable to a client with a recharge code. This lowers the net cost concern of an overspend.

factors.name: prior_exceptions_12m
factors.description: Count of exception requests by the same employee in the last 12 months. High counts raise concern unless most were approved.

factors.name: booking_lead_days
factors.description: Days between booked_on and departure. Short leads look discretionary but are often explained by a disruption.

factors.name: employee_grade
factors.description: Grade band, which sets the cap in the policy section. It is largely a decoy, though the cap must be read for the right band.

sections.name: request
sections.description: Claim header: req_id, emp_ref, grade, cost_centre, trip_ref, breach_rule, requested_total, ccy, submitted_on, payroll_cutoff.

sections.name: lines
sections.description: Itemised list of line_no, date, category, cost_centre, amount, ccy, fx_rate, amount_gbp, receipt_attached.

sections.name: policy
sections.description: Applicable rule: rule_id, grade_band, cap_gbp, cap_unit, units, reviewer_limit_gbp.

sections.name: travel
sections.description: Trip context: trip_ref, depart, return, booked_on, disruption object or null, alt_check object, client_recharge object.

sections.name: approvals
sections.description: Line manager approval, pre_approval object or null, and attendees list where relevant.

sections.name: history
sections.description: Employee record: exceptions_12m, approved_12m, declined_12m, last_exception_on.

F330.rendering_notes:
There are no free-text fields; every signal is a number, date, code, boolean or null.

How each factor appears in the record:
- true_excess_pct is never stated. The reader computes it from the sum of lines.amount_gbp (after removing a duplicated line) against policy.cap_gbp x policy.units.
- amount_mismatch shows in three ways: request.requested_total disagrees with the line sum, one line's fx_rate x amount does not equal its amount_gbp, or two lines repeat the same date, category and amount.
- reference_mismatch shows as a lines[].date outside travel.depart to travel.return, as request.trip_ref differing from travel.trip_ref, or as a lines[].cost_centre differing from request.cost_centre.
- pre_approval_state is approvals.pre_approval {ref, trip_ref, max_gbp, valid_to} or null. Expired means valid_to is before travel.depart. Different_trip means its trip_ref differs. Max_below_excess means max_gbp is less than the computed excess.
- external_disruption is travel.disruption {code, source, logged_on} when true, and null when false.
- compliant_option is travel.alt_check {options_seen, compliant_found} as a count and boolean, or null when not checked.
- missing_item appears as lines[].receipt_attached false on the breaching line, as approvals.line_mgr.approved null, or as approvals.attendees being an empty list for entertainment.
- excess_vs_authority is derived by comparing the computed excess in GBP with policy.reviewer_limit_gbp.
- client_rechargeable is travel.client_recharge {billable, client_code}.
- prior_exceptions_12m and its outcomes are in the history section.
- booking_lead_days is derived from travel.booked_on against travel.depart.
- employee_grade appears in request.grade and policy.grade_band; these always agree, and the cap follows from them.

Counting discrepancies: each differing corresponding value counts once, across these pairs:
- requested_total against the line sum
- fx arithmetic on each line
- duplicated lines
- line dates against the trip window
- trip_ref across request, travel and pre_approval
- cost_centre between request and lines

An expired pre-approval is a validity failure, not a cross-section mismatch.

Decoys: payroll_cutoff, last_exception_on, small receipted lines unrelated to the breach, grade, and ccy on lines already converted correctly.

The record never states an answer. There must be no fields for excess percentage, discrepancy count, recommended outcome, 'within control', risk or coverage verdict, and no field labelled as a mismatch. Mitigating fields (disruption, recharge, valid pre-approval, mostly approved history) are placed with and without alarming signals at roughly equal rates.

F331.role: Household storm claims intake handler at a home insurer, reviewing each newly lodged claim file before it is routed
F331.setting: A regional home insurer receives storm damage claims after wind, hail and heavy rain events. The intake handler opens one claim file at a time. The file holds policy details, the claimant's loss report, an automated weather lookup, property history, a contractor estimate and a checklist of lodged documents. The handler checks whether the storm is corroborated and whether damage predates it. They then decide how the claim proceeds and how urgently make-safe work is needed. Signals are often indirect: dates in one section must be compared with dates in another, estimates with benchmarks, and survey notes with the claimed damage area.

weather_corroborated.instructions: Recorded weather at the property supports a storm on the loss date.

criteria.true: Station data near property shows qualifying storm that day.
criteria.false: No qualifying event, distant station only, or dates differ.

pre_existing_damage.instructions: File evidence shows claimed damage existed before the reported storm.

criteria.true: Earlier survey or claim records the same damage area.
criteria.false: No dated evidence places the damage before the storm.

intake_route.instructions: How should this claim proceed after intake review?
